title: Detention and Yearbook
author: Isandro Sterling
blurb: Dominic Montrose, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, has spent twelve years being so careful it hurts. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide who to be when the labels come off before graduation.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
